description: This file implements the WarningReportingUnit class, which manages warning categories, their configuration, and reporting within the Thunder framework. It includes methods for singleton access, category management, configuration serialization/deserialization, and event reporting.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing warning categories, their configurations, and reporting warning events within the Thunder framework.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::WarningReportingUnit
methods.description: Constructor initializing internal data structures and registering the instance with the proxy.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::~WarningReportingUnit
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up categories and unregistering the instance.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::GetCategories
methods.description: Returns a list of all warning category names.

methods.description: Adds a category control to the internal category list.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a category control from the internal category list.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Defaults
methods.description: Serializes current enabled categories to a JSON string.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Defaults(const string&)
methods.description: Deserializes categories from a JSON string and updates internal state.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::UpdateEnabledCategories
methods.description: Updates the enabled/disabled state and configuration of categories based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific category, including whether it is default, enabled, and its configuration.

methods.description: Reports a warning event with associated information.
